title: Whether true and properly so-called theology can be in an ungodly human being
pass_a_gloss: Article XXX. Whether true and properly so-called theology can be in an ungodly — that is, unregenerate — human being. 1. The question is whether an ungodly human being — a hypocrite, heretic, or merely learned person — can have true theology. 2. If theology is taken for bare historical knowledge of the articles and of scholastic conclusions, it can be in the ungodly: demons and hypocrites know many true things about God. 3. If theology is taken properly for saving wisdom, or living faith joined with the fear of God and obedience, it cannot be in the ungodly unregenerate: because such theology is the Holy Spirit's gift, inseparable from charity and saving faith. 4. Therefore we conclude: theology properly so called is not in the ungodly; although we grant that acquired theological knowledge and the history of faith are given in them. End of the Third Exercise.
pass_b_english: Article XXX. Whether true and properly so-called theology can be in an ungodly human being.
1. Can an ungodly person — hypocrite, heretic, or merely learned — have true theology?
2. As bare historical knowledge of articles and scholastic conclusions: yes. Demons and hypocrites know many true things about God.
3. As saving wisdom — living faith with fear of God and obedience: no. That theology is the Spirit's gift, inseparable from charity and saving faith.
4. Conclusion: theology properly so called is not in the ungodly; acquired theological knowledge and faith's history may be. End of the Third Exercise.
source_text:
ART. XXX.
An vera & proprie dicta Theologia possit esse in homine impio, seu non regenerato.

1. Quaeritur an homo impius — hypocrita, haereticus, aut mere literatus — veram Theologiam habere possit.

2. Si Theologia sumatur pro nuda notitia historica articulorum & conclusionum Scholasticarum, potest inesse impio: daemones & hypocritaе multa vera de DEO sciunt.

3. Si Theologia sumatur proprie pro sapientia salvifica, seu fide viva conjuncta cum timore DEI & obedientia, non potest inesse impio non regenerato: quia talis Theologia est donum Spiritus Sancti, a charitate & fide salvifica inseparabilis.

4. Ideo concludimus: Theologiam proprie dictam non esse in impiis; quamvis notitiam theologicam acquisitam & historiam fidei in iis dari concedamus. FINIS Exercitationis Tertiae.
